how.title: Three steps. As simple as that.
how.sub: No tech skills needed. You copy a link, pick your size, and we handle everything else.

steps.title: Copy the product link
steps.body: Grab the link of the piece you want from the brand’s website (Zara, COS, Sézane…). We automatically pull the name, photo, price and all available sizes.

steps.title: Pick your size (and colour)
steps.body: Select YOUR size and YOUR colour. We’ll only let you know about that one — not some random size that isn’t yours.

steps.title: Get your alert in under 5 min
steps.body: Email straight to your inbox (and SMS on Pro) the moment it’s back. With a link that takes you right to the product page, in your size.
steps.pill: Faster than the brand’s own alert

details.title: We check non-stop
details.body: We look at the product page every 5 minutes (Pro) or 30 minutes (Free). We check the buy button and the stock info directly on the site — just like you would, but without you having to think about it.

details.title: Two checks before we tell you
details.body: We make sure it’s really back before we send anything. If an item reappears for 30 seconds because someone abandoned their cart, we don’t wake you up. No false hope.

details.title: We respect the stores
details.body: We only look at what’s publicly visible. No hacking, no auto-buying. We browse the same page you see, at human speed.

details.title: Data stored in Europe
details.body: Everything is hosted in Frankfurt, encrypted and GDPR compliant. Your email and alerts belong to you. Export or delete them in one click. We never sell anything to anyone.

details.title: Email and SMS alerts
details.body: As soon as your size is back, you get an email with a direct link to the product page, in your size. On Pro, we also text you for items that sell out fast. No hidden newsletter.

how.whyTitle: Why is this better than the brand’s own alerts?

whyItems.title: Faster
whyItems.body: Brands send their alerts in batches — sometimes 2 to 24 hours late. We check each product live, no queue. On average, you’ll know in under 3 minutes.

whyItems.title: Your exact size
whyItems.body: Brands send a generic alert for the product. If size S comes back and you wear M, you get a notification for nothing. We only let you know about the size you’re watching.

whyItems.title: All your brands, one place
whyItems.body: No need to create accounts at Zara, COS, Sézane and cross your fingers that each one’s alerts work. One place, every brand, every size.

items.q: How does it work behind the scenes?
items.a: We check the product page every 5 minutes (Pro) or 30 minutes (Free). We look at the buy button, we read the stock info. If the page is tricky, we open it like a normal browser and look. Nothing magical.

items.q: Why are you faster than the brands?
items.a: Brands send their alerts in batches — sometimes 24 hours late. We check your product live, all the time. Simple: we don’t wait in their email queue.

items.q: How many items can I track?
items.a: 3 on Free, 20 on Pro. Each size+colour counts as 1. If you want a t-shirt in S and M, that’s 2 alerts. Swap anytime.
Our focus is Europe, but we already cover Aritzia, Reformation, Khaite. If the site is in English or French, it should work. Tell us which one you need.

manifesto.title: Because there are enough sold-out signs already.
paragraphs: We’re tired of checking. Tired of alerts arriving after it’s already gone. Tired of tools that make no sense.
Restocking is what we always wanted. One link, one size, one alert. That’s it.
Three people between Paris, Lyon and Berlin. No fundraising, no AI bullshit, no selling data. Just a service that makes fashion a little less frustrating.
We started this after missing a COS coat for the third time. Size S, navy blue. Restocked at 4am, gone by 4:07. Not a single alert. That’s when we knew.
Today we watch 120+ brands every 5 minutes. We check product pages like you would — just without you having to think about it. Nothing magical, just good work.
We don’t spam you. We don’t sell you. We let you know when it’s really back, in your size, for the item you want. Full stop.
We do this so you wear what you love — not what’s left.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Restocking, we hate spam as much as you do. Your data is used only to notify you when your favorite item comes back in stock.

sections.title: Data Collected
sections.content: We keep your email, your language preference, and the product URLs you watch. That's all.

sections.title: Data Usage
sections.content: Your email is only used to send alerts and important service updates. We will NEVER sell your data to third parties.

sections.title: Hosting
sections.content: Your data is stored in Europe (Frankfurt region) on Supabase's secure servers.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using Restocking, you agree to these simple rules.

sections.title: The Service
sections.content: Restocking is a monitoring tool. We do our best to be the fastest, but we cannot guarantee that you will succeed in buying the product before others.

sections.title: Fair Use
sections.content: The service is intended for personal use. Any attempt at massive automation or degradation of the service may result in a ban.

sections.title: Pro Subscription
sections.content: The Pro plan is no-commitment. You can cancel at any time from your dashboard.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: We use the strict minimum to keep the site running.

sections.title: Essential Cookies

sections.title: Analytics
